summary: Build KPI scorecards, define measures, and strengthen performance reporting with practical tools. Enrol in 5-day training.
lede: KPI architecture and performance measurement design turns strategy, operational goals, and review cycles into a measurement system built for action. This course shows you how to align objectives, select meaningful measures, set targets and thresholds, and connect data to decision-ready dashboards using KPI trees, the KPI dictionary, MPRA, and Balanced Scorecard logic. You will build practical outputs including a KPI register, measure definition table, and performance dashboard brief while developing discipline around review cycles and objective-to-measure traceability. Workshops cover measure selection, target logic, dashboard structure, data visualization, and process mapping, with an overview of governance and automation considerations for larger deployments.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who design, review, or rely on performance measures and need a practical system for KPI architecture and performance measurement design.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of organizational objectives, operational reporting, and basic spreadsheet use. No programming is required, but familiarity with Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool is helpful for KPI definition, measure mapping, and dashboard exercises. Prior exposure to performance reporting, balanced scorecards, or management reporting will make the exercises easier to apply, but it is not mandatory.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
